entities.summary: Serik Temirzhanov is a Kazakh boxer. He competed in the men's featherweight event at the 2020 Summer Olympics held in Tokyo, Japan. He lost to Duke Ragan of America in the Second round. He also competed at the 2021 World Championships, where he won a medal.
